page.overview:
What is Court of Azathoth?

The Court of Azathoth is a place mentioned in the Cthulhu Mythos. Sometimes it is called "the Final Void". Its relationship to the Last Void is unclear.

The Court of Azathoth, also known as the "Mouth of Madness", is located at the center of the universe, beyond time and space. (: The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath, : Malleus Monstrorum (2006 edition))

The Court stands on a plane beyond space and time, serving as the abode for the Blind Idiot God Azathoth, "the foolish Daemon Sultan." There, the almighty Outer God remains dormant by the sounds sung by amorphous flute players. Both Nyarlathotep and Yog-Sothoth are known to visit the Court of Azathoth to review the state he is in after some time.

Court of Azathoth is only chaos, going beyond dimensional space, time, and matter, without form or location. (: Fungi from Yuggoth). Also, it is also said that Azathoth is “beyond angled space.” (: The Whisperer in Darkness).
